tagline: An open-source, auditable network gateway for homes and servers
intro: DDNS, STUN traversal, port forwarding, reverse proxy, SSL certificates, WAF and more in a single binary. Every line of code is public and every outbound address is visible.
upToDate: You are on the latest version
updateHint: api.github.com is contacted only when you click Check for Updates. Gately never goes online on its own.
dockerNote: The Docker image supports amd64, arm64 and arm/v7. Host networking is recommended so Gately can listen on the host's ports.
binaryNote: You can also download Linux / macOS / Windows / FreeBSD binaries from {releases} and run {cmd}.
stepExportDesc: Find {file} in the Lucky config directory, or the full-site config zip.
stepImportDesc: Upload it in {link}, preview, then import. Imported rules are disabled by default.
stepSwitchDesc: Module by module, disable it in Lucky and enable it in Gately. Stop Lucky once everything checks out.
copyFailed: Copy failed, please select the text manually

openSource.title: Open source
openSource.desc: The source code is open under Apache-2.0. Anyone can review, build and contribute.

noTelemetry.title: No data sent back
noTelemetry.desc: Gately never contacts project servers or reports device information. Third-party login uses your own OAuth app.

visibleAddr.title: Visible outbound addresses
visibleAddr.desc: Every outbound address, such as public IP lookup and STUN servers, is visible, editable and can be turned off.

plainConfig.title: Plain-text config
plainConfig.desc: Configuration is plain JSON that you can put under git for auditing and rollback.
